title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Supplementing and Adding Causes of Action for Civil Cases
keywords_en: Copyright; Intellectual Property; Supplementary Addition of Civil Cases by the Court
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Supplementing and Increasing Causes of Action in Civil Cases

Fa [2018] No. 364

To: All Higher People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; and all units of this Court:

Upon review, it is hereby notified that three categories of causes of action are to be added under Part Five "Intellectual Property and Competition Disputes" of the "Provisions on Causes of Action in Civil Cases" as follows:

1. Under the second-level cause "14. Intellectual Property Ownership and Infringement Disputes", under the third-level cause "145. Disputes over Ownership and Infringement of New Plant Variety Rights", add one fourth-level cause: "(4) Disputes over royalty for use during the provisional protection period of new plant variety rights";

2. Under the second-level cause "14. Intellectual Property Ownership and Infringement Disputes", under "153. Disputes over Confirmation of Non-Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights", add three fourth-level causes: "(4) Disputes over confirmation of non-infringement of new plant variety rights; (5) Disputes over confirmation of non-infringement of exclusive rights in layout designs of integrated circuits; (6) Disputes over confirmation of non-infringement of computer software copyrights".

3. Under the second-level cause "14. Intellectual Property Ownership and Infringement Disputes", under "154. Disputes over Liability for Damages Caused by Applying for Interim Measures in Intellectual Property", add two fourth-level causes: "(6) Disputes over liability for damages caused by applying for a pre-litigation injunction to stop infringement of computer software copyrights; (7) Disputes over liability for damages caused by applying for a pre-litigation injunction to stop infringement of exclusive rights in layout designs of integrated circuits".

This notice shall come into effect as of January 1, 2019.

December 28, 2018
